question: What worldly and otherworldly results are promised for this worship?
premises: The verse names becoming king in this world.
It names becoming Shiva-like in the other world.
inference: The practitioner gains kingship here and Shiva-likeness hereafter.
uncertainties: The fused form bhavedrājā is analyzed as one token.
plain_english: In this world one becomes king; in the other world one becomes Shiva-like.
